name: smu-elearn
description: Read-only access to SMU eLearn courses, pinned courses, weekly modules, documents, search, metadata, and downloads.

interface.shortDescription: Browse SMU courses and weekly documents.
interface.longDescription: Connects to SMU eLearn through a local read-only MCP server. Open Chrome for user-controlled SMU SSO/MFA, then list courses and pinned courses, inspect weekly modules, find recent or course-specific documents, search content, read metadata, and download files locally.
defaultPrompt: List my pinned SMU eLearn courses.
Show this week's new eLearn documents.
Find the Week 3 documents for a course.
